digest.component_or_area: plan review attestation and code-drift currency checking
propositions: When file_impact is undeclared, the attestation currently invalidates on ANY code-SHA change, causing 21% of re-reviews to run on byte-identical material; this over-triggers and wastes resources.

The signed manifest must record the normalized read-set (files actually fetched during plan review) so that currency validation can scope invalidation to those paths plus a defined blast-radius of configuration files, rather than all code.

With an empty pre-existing dependency set, undeclared scope, and a recorded read-set, SHA drift should trigger re-review only if a file in the read-set or blast-radius changed; all other code changes are ignored.
Already-scoped, poisoned, or authenticated-none tickets must NOT gain read-set scoping, to avoid widening scope or converting previously exempt tickets to tracked ones.
Unverifiable read-sets, missing read-set fields in legacy attestations, and expansion failures must fall back to the safe behavior of invalidating on any code change.
